headline: Rest today before Thursday's group easy run
summary: Garmin recorded 6h 15m of confirmed sleep with a score of 73. Sleeping heart rate was 68 bpm, near recent baselines, but overnight HRV fell to 33 ms versus a 38 ms weekly average and Body Battery was only 42 on waking. Take full rest from running and cycling today so Thursday's regular group easy run remains available if the next overnight record and symptoms are acceptable.

recommendation.title: Full rest from running and cycling
details: Do not run or cycle today. Optional only: 20–30 minutes of easy walking or 10–15 minutes of gentle mobility.
Do not add tempo work, intervals, hills, strides, a fast finish, or make-up distance despite the low acute load.
If Thursday's overnight record is reassuring and there are no concerning symptoms, the regular Thursday group easy run can be the next session: approximately 7–8 km at conversational RPE 2–3.
recommendation.alternative: Full rest with normal daily movement is the lower-load choice; skip even optional walking if unusually sleepy, dizzy, dehydrated, ill, or if movement aggravates pain.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop optional movement for pain that changes gait, dizziness, unusual sleepiness, dehydration symptoms, illness, chest symptoms, or any other concerning symptom. Current symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.
